recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this short-description issue unless PA separately decides to revisit the broader HealthcareService.active long definition.
issue_request: FHIR-13453 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for STU3 asking that the HealthcareService.active short description say that the HealthcareService record is in active use rather than implying the healthcare service itself is active.
initial_application: The request was applied in git commit 78b39f30cdbfa85f6d37f5ec56c46ff002f7bbd3, which changed the HealthcareService spreadsheet short text from "Whether this healthcareservice is in active use" to "Whether this HealthcareService record is in active use" and expanded the long definition. The 2021 source refactor commit 33b409a4b6d preserved that short text in source/healthcareservice/structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml.
additional_context: HealthcareService is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source/healthcareservice/structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml line 119 contains the requested short text, and searches for the exact issue key found no relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion that would alter the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the active current source already implements the FHIR-13453 correction.
